settings.title: Settings
settings.redactHint: What the model finds and blacks out – one item per line.
settings.keepHint: What stays readable, even when it looks similar.
settings.notesPlaceholder: For example: “These are orthopedic medical reports. Do not black out the names of doctors.”
settings.contactsRule: Always black out phone numbers and e-mail addresses
settings.contactsRuleHint: Safety rule: catches every number and address – also those of organizations that the list keeps readable.
settings.fixedHint: The answer format and the safety rules of the instruction are built in, so that a document cannot steer the model.
settings.nextDocument: Applies from the next analyzed document.
settings.readerLocalHint: GLM-OCR – the pages do not leave the computer.
settings.readerCloudHint: The pages are read in Switzerland (swissdocai.ch). Billed per page.
settings.readerNoneHint: Only the recognized words – fastest, less context.
settings.readerIntro: A reading model transcribes each page. The personal data is searched in this text; the recognized words show where to black it out. So two readings check each other.
settings.readerNoneDetail: Without a reading model, personal data is searched only in the recognized words, line by line. This is the fastest option, and nearly as good for PDFs with a text layer. For scans and photos with columns, tables or letterheads, context is lost (whose name is this?), and a misread name is no longer caught by a second reading. For scans and photos, choose a reading model.
settings.tokenSaved: Saved ({{hint}}) – enter a new token to change it.
settings.tokenHint: You find the token in the SwissDocAI console under “API tokens”.
settings.tokenMissing: SwissDocAI Cloud needs an API token.
settings.piiIntro: A language model searches the text of the pages for personal data, following your lists under “What to black out”.
settings.piiLocalHint: Gemma 4 E4B – the text does not leave the computer.
settings.piiCloudHint: Only the text of the pages is checked in Switzerland (swissdocai.ch), no images. Billed per page.
settings.cloudCostOne: Each page of a document costs 1 page of credit.
settings.cloudCostBoth: Each page of a document costs 2 pages of credit: one for reading it, one for the personal data.
settings.titledRule: Always black out names after a title (Dr., Prof., PD)
settings.titledRuleHint: Safety rule: “Dr. med. Example” is always a person – even when the model takes it for part of the organization.
settings.qrRuleHint: A QR code can hold personal data that is not printed on the page – the payment part of a QR-bill holds names, addresses and the IBAN. Every QR code found is blacked out whole.

setup.title: One-time setup
setup.text: To work completely on this computer, the app downloads its models once (about {{gb}} GB). After that it works offline.
setup.gpuSmall: Graphics processor: {{gpu}} – too little memory of its own for the language model, so it runs on the processor (slower).
setup.cpu: No suitable graphics processor found. The models run on the processor – this works, but more slowly.
